mentions.name: Network Weather
mentions.description: A desktop tool for macOS and Windows that helps non-technical users figure out what is wrong with their home internet and how to fix it, probing networks, WiFi, and the operating system to diagnose issues. Aimed at keeping remote/hybrid/on-the-road employees productive and reducing first-line helpdesk tickets about home network issues and Zoom glitches.
mentions.problem: Non-technical users struggle to diagnose and fix home internet/WiFi problems, and companies and helpdesks waste time triaging tickets about home network issues and Zoom glitches.
mentions.audience: Non-technical users with home internet issues; companies and helpdesks triaging remote employees' home network problems
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working to build a tool for macOS and Windows desktops to help non-technical users figure out what's wrong with their home internet and how to fix it. https://www.networkweather.com/
